description:
Record money received against threads in the vault's payments directory.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c ISO] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — record a receipt
  list [THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--as-of YYYY-MM-DD] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed vs received, by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount AMOUNT] [-c ISO] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change one field of a payment
  rm ID [-y] — delete a payment

Flags:
  log: THREAD is a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink; AMOUNT is the amount received, positive. -c ISO currency code, defaults to the thread's; -d date received, default today; -t time, default now; -a which account it landed in; -n free-text note. --all only affects the interactive form.
  statement: --as-of statement date driving aging, default today; --pdf renders a PDF to the given path and requires --thread.
  rm: -y skips confirmation.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "12500", "-c", "ZAR", "-d", "2026-06-14", "-a", "Business"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--as-of", "2026-06-30", "--json"]
  ["rm", "a1b2c3d4", "-y"]

Notes:
  Never call `log` without THREAD and AMOUNT — with them missing it enters interactive capture and reads from stdin.
  Money received must always name a currency, from -c or the thread; amounts must be positive, a refund is not a negative payment.
  ID is the 8-hex-char payment id; the id namespace is shared with `hours`.
  `statement` counts billed time from `hours`; entries with no currency are ignored.
  Each recorded payment also drops a REF into the buffer, filed under the date received, which reaches the thread's daily log on the next `buffer flush`.
  `rm` permanently deletes the record.
